name: eslint-plugin-aquaculture
description: Custom ESLint rules for the aquaculture platform. Workspace-local plugin resolved by ESLint via the canonical `eslint-plugin-<name>` convention; referenced as `aquaculture` in .eslintrc.json plugins array. Each rule encodes a CLAUDE.md / ADR invariant that is cheaper to catch at lint time than at runtime. See /root/.claude/plans/declarative-riding-shamir.md BLOCKER-20.
